Smart Energy Monitoring

Performance tracking for solar arrays, batteries, and energy assets

A purpose-built monitoring platform for solar and energy infrastructure — connecting energy meters, inverters, and sensors to live dashboards with performance analytics and fault alerting.

Problem: Energy operators have limited visibility into how their solar panels, inverters, batteries, and transformers are performing in real time.

Features: Solar/inverter monitoring, Battery state tracking, Energy yield analytics, Fault alerts, Export reports, Mobile access.

Target users: Solar installers, energy utilities, commercial building managers, off-grid energy operators.

Who is Smart Energy Monitoring for? Solar installers, energy utilities, commercial building managers, off-grid energy operators

What problem does this product solve? Energy operators have limited visibility into how their solar panels, inverters, batteries, and transformers are performing in real time.

Can AICORE customise this product? Yes. AICORE can adapt product workflows, integrations, dashboards, user roles, and deployment details around your organisation's requirements.
